title: Spicy Kielbasa Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with spicy kielbasa and a variety of vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced kielbasa and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and onion to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and stir-fry sauce.
Pour the sauce into the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
